settings.title: Custom Layout
settings.desc: Every plot, block and road is reproduced accurately so visitors grasp the full scope of the project in a single glance.

settings.title: LED Lighting
settings.desc: Commercial buildings have LED lighting installed which brings the property to life. Street lights included as well.

settings.title: Branding and LOGO
settings.desc: The base carries your company branding and logo, turning the model into a centrepiece that reinforces your identity at every viewing.

settings.q: Can you build my specific development layout?
settings.a: Yes. We build from your master-plan drawings and CAD files, accurate to scale.

settings.q: Can it include LED lighting and zone colours?
settings.a: Yes - LED zone lighting, colour-coded phases and landmark highlighting are all available.

settings.q: How large can the model be?
settings.a: This is a 3-metre build; we produce models from tabletop scale up to large multi-section installations. Tell us your sizes.

settings.q: Do you ship and install worldwide?
settings.a: Yes, we crate and ship worldwide from Dubai; large models are built in sections for transport.

settings.hero_desc: A 3-metre master-plan model that puts an entire development in front of your buyers - every plot, road and zone reproduced to scale on a branded display platform. Built for sales galleries and launch events where investors need to see the whole vision at once.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your development layout, branding, scale and zone colours
settings.desc_title_em: the Whole Project at a Glance?
settings.s1_body: A master-plan model sells the vision in a way drawings and screens cannot. At 3 metres, this model lays out the entire development - plots, road network, landscaping and landmarks - all to scale on a platform finished in your brand identity. Buyers and investors gather around it, orient themselves instantly, and understand the project in seconds. We build it from your plans and keep it accurate to the latest layout.
settings.case_heading: The Heart of the Sales Gallery
settings.case_body: Commissioned as the centrepiece for Rasikhoon real-estate sales gallery, this 3-metre master plan gave the developer's team a single, tangible reference to present every phase of the project to investors and buyers - on brand, to scale, and built to be updated as the development evolves.
settings.case_quote: Clients finally see the whole project at a glance. It has become the centre of every exhibition we participate.
settings.case_quote_attr: Malek - Sales Manager of Rasikhoon Real Estate
settings.prov_p: A scale model turns abstract plans into something investors can stand over, point at and believe in. That sense of scale and permanence is exactly what closes high-value real-estate decisions. The vision, made tangible.
